fato_historico: 1944: The ammunition ship USS Mount Hood explodes at Seeadler Harbour, Manus, Admiralty Islands, killing at least 432 and wounding 371.
energia_do_dia: The stars suggest a day to honor your grounded spirit. Just as memories of past storms remind us of the fragility of peace, you may find power in protecting your own tranquility. It is a good time to nurture your sanctuary, grounding yourself in stability while staying open to the gentle currents of renewal and unexpected growth.
frase_do_dia: Deep roots allow the tree to sway gracefully through the strongest winds.
significado_numero: Represents the stability of the earth and your solid foundation.
conselho: Consider planting seeds of kindness in your own life to foster lasting abundance.
